title: Cash Flow Stress Test for SMEs
description: Applies configurable stress shocks (revenue drop −20%/−40%, payment delay +15/+30 days, unexpected capex) to a 13-week rolling cash flow model. Returns cash runway, minimum cash balance, and week-by-week stressed cash flow table with breach alerts. Markdown cash management memo export. Client-side. Zero PII.

minCashBuffer.description: Alert threshold — minimum acceptable cash balance

capexAmount.description: Unexpected capex amount if shock enabled

baseRunway.description: Week number when base cash drops below buffer, or null if 13+ weeks

stressRunway.description: Week number when stressed cash drops below buffer, or null if 13+ weeks

minStressed.description: Minimum cash balance over 13 weeks under stress

mcp_tool_definition.name: stress_test_sme_cashflow
mcp_tool_definition.description: Run a 13-week rolling cash flow stress test for an SME. Apply configurable shocks (revenue drops, payment delays, unexpected capex) and return cash runway, minimum cash balance, and week-by-week stressed cash flow. Use to assess near-term liquidity risk and generate cash management recommendations. The 13-week horizon is the FCA standard for near-term liquidity stress assessment.
